title: Close the September 2026 PeakLive audit and deliver its future-ready roadmap

request.theme: Trustworthy, responsive, and future-ready CAN workstation
needs: Resolve every finding in the September 2026 audit without treating completed historical Logics work as proof that its claimed outcome remains present.
Restore measurement correctness: all acquired and replayed frames must feed facts, the frame cache, deferred decode, and series state; only visual projection may be coalesced.
Make routine failure modes recoverable and explicit, including corrupt profiles, unavailable adapters, collision-safe recording, malformed traces, and application close during export.
Deliver a coherent English diagnostic-tool interface and a sequenced roadmap for capabilities that are intentionally deferred or depend on future adapters and formats.
context: docs/audit-2026-09.md is the authoritative evidence source. It records 96 findings, eight P0 reliability failures, performance and visual-system defects, product capability gaps, and architecture debt. Its Linux/offscreen measurements are acceptance baselines, not Windows or hardware certification.
The operator confirmed scope covers all 44 audit roadmap actions. Existing Done Logics chains are not accepted as evidence and must not be relied upon without current tests or code evidence.
Validation scope is correction plus Linux automated tests. Windows and live PCAN acceptance are roadmap evidence, not a release gate for this corpus.

Adapter policy is automatic reconnect with a visible alert. Live acquisition and replay are mutually exclusive: attempting the other source is refused with a clear alert, preserving the active session. The operator chose an export wait dialog with an explicit confirm-to-force-close action.

Corrupt profiles are renamed to a timestamped backup, a default profile is used, and a warning dialog is shown. Non-discriminating recording templates receive a numeric suffix; reservation searches at most 10000 candidates.

The required aggregate-ID view defaults to identifier, latest frame, count, mean period, current delta-t, bus load or bitrate contribution when available, and decode status. Recent sessions and files are implementation scope; bitrate scan and adapter discovery are roadmap commitments.

The UI language, product copy, and Logics documents are English. The visual baseline is a Fusion dark application palette, semantic control variants, explicit interactive states, QPainter icons, and diagnostic-data legibility.

Future BLF/MDF, additional adapters, and CAN transmit are roadmap commitments. CAN transmit remains explicitly out of the current delivered product scope until a separately approved implementation chain is promoted.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Every P0 item is implemented with focused Linux automated tests that fail against the audited behaviour; no P0 failure can freeze, silently corrupt a result, or silently prevent application start.

AC2: All captured and replayed frames update session facts, frame cache, deferred decode inputs, and series state exactly once; trace and graph rendering may remain bounded and coalesced independently.
AC3: Acquisition and replay cannot mix their data. Configuration passed to a worker is immutable for that session, and invalid recording templates cannot be persisted.
AC4: Adapter error recovery uses bounded automatic reconnect with an explicit operator alert and rate-limited, rotating recording evidence.
AC5: A malformed profile or trace, a failed post-connect recording start, an export during close, and recording-name collisions each have an explicit, tested operator outcome.

AC6: The UI has an application-wide Fusion dark palette, accessible semantic states, consistent control geometry, data-aligned typography, and tests or targeted assertions for stateful behaviour where practical.

AC7: Filtering, signal search, profile persistence, graph refresh, DBC decoding, export, replay, and trace browsing meet documented bounded-work rules and their tests assert counts or deterministic bounds rather than elapsed time alone.

AC8: The aggregate identifier view and recent-session/file workflows are delivered, and the roadmap explicitly sequences bitrate scanning, adapter enumeration, capture-format ports, additional adapters, BLF/MDF, and future CAN transmission.
AC9: Documentation makes no claim for a feature that is absent from code, and explains which roadmap items require hardware or a later product decision.
AC10: The generated request chain validates with Logics Manager, includes a deep context pack, passes lint and audit, and is commit-ready with the audit and supplied external evidence.

product.title: PeakLive audit closure and future-ready CAN workstation roadmap
product.overview: A complete, evidence-driven remediation and delivery roadmap that makes PeakLive correct under load, resilient under failure, legible as a professional CAN diagnostic tool, and deliberately extensible toward new formats, adapters, and later CAN transmission.
goals: Eliminate the audit's P0 freezes, crashes, silent data loss, and false-success outcomes.
Preserve exhaustive measurement facts while bounding visual work and continuous-input work.
Make the most important diagnostic workflows discoverable, fast, and visually unambiguous.
Replace accidental architecture constraints with tested extension seams and an honest capability roadmap.
Keep implementation evidence current rather than relying on historical Done status.
non_goals: Guarantee Windows or physical-PCAN certification in this delivery; those remain tracked acceptance work after Linux proof.
Ship CAN transmission before its separate product and safety decision chain is approved.
Add remote telemetry, cloud services, or automatic software updates.
Perform a wholesale rewrite where a bounded, tested correction is sufficient.

backlog_items.title: Bound recording-name reservation and cancel it safely
backlog_items.priority: High - prevents a reproducible total startup freeze
problem: A non-discriminating recording template loops forever during reservation.
scope_in: Limit candidate search to 10000.
Add a numeric suffix after identical consecutive expansions.
Honour worker cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: A repeated {profile}.asc name reserves a suffixed path or fails clearly within the bound.
Stop cancels reservation and tests cover both paths.

backlog_items.title: Recover safely from a corrupt profile store
backlog_items.priority: High - prevents application startup
problem: Unreadable or invalid profiles.json crashes before the window exists.
scope_in: Catch parse, I/O, and invalid-value errors.
Rename the source to a timestamped corrupt backup.
Start with defaults and show an English warning dialog.
acceptance_criteria: Corrupt JSON, invalid controller mode, and invalid bitrate start the application on defaults.
The backup path is logged and the operator sees a warning.

backlog_items.title: Separate exhaustive ingestion from visual coalescing
backlog_items.priority: High - current reports can silently be false
problem: Presentation-frame replacement drops over 90 percent of frames before facts, cache, series, and deferred decode.
scope_in: Ingest every frame once into facts, cache, series, and deferred-decode inputs.
Coalesce only trace and graph projection.
Define bounded ownership and test high-rate acquisition and replay.
acceptance_criteria: A high-rate synthetic stream yields exact facts and cache counts while rendered rows remain bounded.
Deferred decode sees the full retained cache, not a presentation sample.

backlog_items.title: Disconnect the adapter after a post-connect start failure
backlog_items.priority: High - otherwise the CAN channel is unusable until restart
problem: Failure reserving or opening a recording after connect leaks the adapter handle.
scope_in: Disconnect on every failure after connect.
Record the connected state early enough for shutdown cleanup.
Test inaccessible target and recorder-start failure.
acceptance_criteria: A failed start disconnects exactly once and a later start can reconnect.

backlog_items.title: Own export workers independently of transient dialogs
backlog_items.priority: High - closing during export can abort the process
problem: A running QThread is owned by its dialog and is destroyed with the window.
scope_in: Create export workers without dialog ownership.
Track them at window level.
Show a waiting dialog on close with explicit force-close confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Close during export waits visibly, can be explicitly forced, and never destroys a running QThread.
Interrupted output is marked incomplete or removed.

backlog_items.title: Rate-limit adapter error events and rotate event-only recordings
backlog_items.priority: High - a disconnected device can flood UI and disk
problem: Persistent driver errors spin hot, queue unlimited signals, and grow event-only recordings without rotation.
scope_in: Deduplicate and rate-limit identical error events.
Back off receive after errors.
Rotate after event writes.
Implement bounded automatic reconnect with visible alert.
acceptance_criteria: Persistent error has bounded signal and recording rate.
Automatic reconnect attempts are bounded and alerted.
Fatal adapter absence reaches a restartable error state.

backlog_items.title: Bound malformed replay diagnostics and prevent false success
backlog_items.priority: High - malformed input can flood the UI and claim completion
problem: Line-numbered anomaly keys defeat aggregation and unhandled worker failures still announce success.
scope_in: Aggregate on stable anomaly codes.
Limit anomaly keys and line length.
Reject implausible input after a documented threshold.
Catch worker exceptions and gate success on actual completion.
acceptance_criteria: Millions of invalid lines yield bounded events and memory.
Binary-like input fails visibly and never reports replay complete.

backlog_items.title: Enforce mutually exclusive immutable live and replay sessions
backlog_items.priority: High - mixing sources makes measurement state incoherent
problem: Live and replay can write the same buffers and live profile edits cross a thread boundary.
scope_in: Refuse starting the other source with an alert while a session is active.
Disable conflicting actions and shortcuts.
Pass workers a profile copy.
Validate recording templates before persistence.
scope_out: Stopping one mode automatically to start another.
acceptance_criteria: Live and replay never share a session buffer.
Mid-session settings edits cannot mutate a worker profile.
Invalid templates are neither saved nor used.

backlog_items.title: Drain abandoned workers safely at process exit
backlog_items.priority: High - abandoned workers currently remain unmanaged
problem: The abandoned-worker collection can retain active threads until interpreter teardown.
scope_in: Attach completion cleanup without race.
Log identity and phase at exit.
Apply the global close budget and explicit forced-close flow.
scope_out: Forcing a stuck vendor driver to return.
acceptance_criteria: Completed abandoned workers are removed.
Active workers at forced exit are reported with evidence and no Qt destruction crash occurs.

backlog_items.title: Make profile writes durable and multi-instance safe
backlog_items.priority: High - atomic replace alone can lose or collide with profile data
problem: A fixed temporary name and no fsync make profile writes vulnerable to interruption and concurrent instances.
scope_in: Use unique temporary names.
Flush and fsync before replace.
Test failure and collision paths.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent stores never share a temporary filename.
Successful writes fsync before replace and failed writes preserve a readable prior file.

backlog_items.title: Debounce filters, signal search, and profile persistence
backlog_items.priority: Medium - routine typing and dragging rebuild too much work
problem: Each keystroke or pointer event triggers expensive reconstruction and a profile write.
scope_in: Use documented single-shot coalescing for filters, signal search, measurements, and save.
Flush pending save on switch and close.
acceptance_criteria: Burst input causes at most one expensive projection and save per window.
Lightweight feedback remains immediate and final state is persisted.

backlog_items.title: Make manual graph zoom disable live follow
backlog_items.priority: Medium - mouse zoom is immediately undone
problem: Manual pyqtgraph range changes do not notify live-follow state.
scope_in: Connect manual range changes to live-follow disable.
Keep explicit re-follow command.
acceptance_criteria: Wheel zoom remains visible after the next refresh and re-follow restores live extent.

backlog_items.title: Decimate plots and bound measurement recomputation
backlog_items.priority: Medium - graph refresh work scales beyond screen resolution
problem: Plots redraw all points and statistics recalculate at 20 Hz.
scope_in: Enable clipping and downsampling.
Coalesce A-B statistics.
Measure with eight signals and separated cursors.
acceptance_criteria: Displayed points are bounded by viewport policy.
Measurement calculations run no more than their documented cadence and preserve final values.

backlog_items.title: Cache DBC decode lookup and deduplicate conflict notices
backlog_items.priority: Medium - repeated lookup and style repolish are per-frame costs
problem: DBC candidates are rebuilt per frame and one conflict can restyle UI per frame.
scope_in: Cache active decode lookup by identifier.
Avoid exception-led unknown-ID flow.
Report each conflict once per session.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated unknown IDs avoid repeated exception work.
A sustained conflict produces one visible report per identifier/session.

backlog_items.title: Deliver an aggregate identifier diagnostics view
backlog_items.priority: Medium - chronological trace alone cannot diagnose a loaded bus
problem: No view aggregates identifiers, period, delta-t, or counts.
scope_in: Add an O(1)-updated aggregate model.
Show ID, latest frame, count, mean period, delta-t, load contribution when known, and decode status by default.
Keep it correct for live and replay.
acceptance_criteria: Each identifier has one updating row with the specified fields.
Counts and period metrics match deterministic fixtures.

backlog_items.title: Replace the trace table with a bounded virtual model
backlog_items.priority: Medium - the widget rebuild creates tens of thousands of items
problem: QTableWidget reconstructs 5000 by 8 cells and blocks the event loop.
scope_in: Use QTableView and QAbstractTableModel over the existing bounded buffer.
Preserve filtering, selection, formatting, and column configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Refresh does not create one Qt item per cell.
Existing trace behaviours remain covered and 5000-row updates meet the documented Linux baseline.

backlog_items.title: Synchronize graph panels incrementally and destroy removed resources
backlog_items.priority: Medium - graph rebuilds leak widgets and connections
problem: Graph sync recreates plots without deterministic teardown.
scope_in: Reuse unchanged graph lanes.
Disconnect and delete removed lanes.
Test repeated deferred decode changes.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated sync leaves stable widget and connection counts.
Existing plots preserve their intended state.

backlog_items.title: Export immutable snapshots with efficient row serialization
backlog_items.priority: Medium - export materializes and deep-copies all rows
problem: Tuple materialization and asdict deep-copy defeat streaming and stress the UI.
scope_in: Hand export an immutable snapshot.
Use direct csv row serialization.
Preserve cancellation and progress.
acceptance_criteria: Large export starts without full UI-thread materialization.
Output matches existing fixtures and is internally consistent during live acquisition.

backlog_items.title: Log all operational failures and expose driver overruns
backlog_items.priority: Medium - diagnostics infrastructure has little operational coverage
problem: Acquisition, replay, DBC, export, and adapter overruns are volatile or ignored.
scope_in: Log each error boundary.
Include normalized driver events in session anomalies and bus state.
acceptance_criteria: Each named failure has structured local log evidence.
Driver overrun and bus warnings are visible in diagnostics and report fixtures.

backlog_items.title: Enforce class-surface architecture budgets
backlog_items.priority: Medium - file-length rules hide a 143-method mixin monolith
problem: Multiple inheritance distributes one implicit window state across files.
scope_in: Add AST-tested class surface budgets.
Forbid defensive getattr on owned state.
Extract two autonomous mixins into collaborators.
acceptance_criteria: Structural tests fail when declared class-surface budgets are exceeded.
The selected collaborators have explicit interfaces and no owned-state getattr workaround.

backlog_items.title: Introduce profile schema migration dispatch
backlog_items.priority: Medium - schema version is written but never read
problem: Migration is inferred from keys and ambiguous filter fields coexist.
scope_in: Read schema version.
Dispatch known migrations.
Clarify typed filter versus DBC state names.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures from supported schema versions migrate deterministically.
Unknown future versions fail safely with an operator-visible outcome.

backlog_items.title: Inject a recorder factory into acquisition workers
backlog_items.priority: Medium - worker seams cannot test disk and rotation behaviour
problem: Worker constructs the recorder directly despite existing injectable seams.
scope_in: Inject a recorder factory and free-space probe.
Add worker-level disk threshold and rotation tests.
acceptance_criteria: Worker tests deterministically simulate disk conditions and rotation.

backlog_items.title: Add complete interactive button states
backlog_items.priority: Medium - controls do not show hover, press, or checked state
problem: QSS defines none of the primary interaction states for buttons.
scope_in: Define hover, pressed, checked, disabled, and focus states.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle state is visually distinguishable and state rules cover buttons and tool buttons.

backlog_items.title: Set Fusion and an application-wide dark palette
backlog_items.priority: Medium - native fragments break dark UI consistency
problem: No fixed Qt style or full palette and stylesheet is window-only.
scope_in: Set Fusion.
Apply named dark palette and application stylesheet.
Style alternate rows and table corner.
acceptance_criteria: Dialogs, tooltips, alternate rows, and table corner use the same dark palette.

backlog_items.title: Render graphs with antialiasing and palette-derived axes
backlog_items.priority: Medium - plots and axes look disconnected from the UI
problem: Curves lack antialiasing and axes/grid ignore theme tokens.
scope_in: Enable pyqtgraph antialiasing.
Set plot background, axis pens, and grid from tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Curves, labels, grid, and background use documented tokens.

backlog_items.title: Standardize table chrome and data typography
backlog_items.priority: Medium - dense diagnostic values are hard to compare
problem: Tables expose native fragments and use proportional, left-aligned numeric data.
scope_in: Hide vertical headers.
Use monospace object-name rules.
Right-align numeric values.
acceptance_criteria: Hex, payload, timestamp, and measurement columns are visually aligned and tables have no unthemed chrome.

backlog_items.title: Create semantic control variants and dominant Start Stop actions
backlog_items.priority: Medium - all buttons look equally important and Start duplicates another glyph
problem: One accent style is used for all commands and critical lifecycle controls are tiny.
scope_in: Add primary, secondary, ghost, and danger variants.
Make Start green and Stop red with separation.
Keep them reachable when central panels collapse.
acceptance_criteria: Lifecycle actions remain reachable and semantically distinct in every workspace layout.

backlog_items.title: Tokenize spacing geometry and stable focus
backlog_items.priority: Medium - inconsistent geometry accumulates visual friction
problem: Fourteen spacing values, competing heights, and focus borders shift layout.
scope_in: Define spacing, height, radius, and focus tokens.
Apply them across workspace and dialogs.
acceptance_criteria: Controls on a shared row use one height and focus never shifts content.

backlog_items.title: Add trace and graph context commands with copy support
backlog_items.priority: Medium - expected diagnostic affordances are absent
problem: No context menu, frame copy, or direct filter action exists.
scope_in: Add copy row, filter identifier, and place cursor at time commands.
Support selection where it is safe.
acceptance_criteria: Context commands operate on deterministic trace and graph fixtures.

backlog_items.title: Create an acquisition command surface with gated actions
backlog_items.priority: Medium - lifecycle commands are misplaced and shortcuts can silently no-op
problem: Start and Stop appear under View and actions are not retained for gating.
scope_in: Add Acquisition menu.
Retain actions and update enabled state by lifecycle phase.
acceptance_criteria: Menu, buttons, and shortcuts present identical enabled state and invalid actions explain why.

backlog_items.title: Show decoded values and graph identity across views
backlog_items.priority: Medium - decoded data exists but is hidden and curves lack correspondence
problem: Trace lacks decoded values and measurement rows are not tied to plot color.
scope_in: Add decoded-value trace presentation.
Color measurement signal identity with graph palette.
Make bus state visible beyond a 12-pixel LED.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture decode values appear in trace and graph-linked measurement rows are unambiguous.

backlog_items.title: Unify recording workflow and refresh reports live
backlog_items.priority: Medium - recording settings are split and report view becomes stale
problem: Recording controls are scattered and reports require manual refresh.
scope_in: Group recording settings under acquisition workflow.
Refresh session report at a bounded cadence while live.
acceptance_criteria: All recording settings are discoverable from one command surface and live report facts update without manual refresh.

backlog_items.title: Replace Unicode command glyphs with QPainter icons
backlog_items.priority: Low - glyph rendering varies by platform
problem: Control icons depend on font glyph interpretation and can become emoji.
scope_in: Create a 16px QPainter icon module and replace command glyphs.
acceptance_criteria: Icons render consistently in offscreen tests and respect enabled and checked state.

backlog_items.title: Deliver recent sessions and recent trace files
backlog_items.priority: Low - documented workflow is currently absent
problem: Recent sessions and files are promised but no workflow exists.
scope_in: Persist bounded recent-session and recent-file lists.
Expose reopen commands with missing-path handling.
acceptance_criteria: Opening or saving updates recents and a missing item has a clear removal or retry outcome.

backlog_items.title: Clarify graph cursors and trace graph linkage
backlog_items.priority: Low - cursor identity and navigation linkage are weak
problem: Cursors lack labels and trace-to-graph navigation is absent.
scope_in: Label and style A/B.
Use live view change signal.
Add markers and bidirectional trace graph navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a trace and a graph point moves the linked context deterministically.

backlog_items.title: Add bus load and real-time counters
backlog_items.priority: Low - operators lack immediate bus health metrics
problem: Bus load and counters are absent from acquisition bar.
scope_in: Calculate and show documented real-time counters and load.
acceptance_criteria: Counters and load match deterministic known-rate fixtures.

backlog_items.title: Introduce capture-writer ports and reader registry
backlog_items.priority: Low - format branching blocks BLF and MDF evolution
problem: ASC recorder embeds TRC branches and readers dispatch on suffix conditionals.
scope_in: Define CaptureWriter port.
Register readers by suffix.
Migrate ASC and TRC without semantic change.
acceptance_criteria: ASC and TRC pass existing fixtures through ports and registry.
BLF/MDF are recorded as next roadmap consumers.

backlog_items.title: Extend adapter capability ports and roadmap discovery
backlog_items.priority: Low - channel and bitrate facts are hard-coded in the UI
problem: Adapter capabilities exist partially but are not consumed; discovery and bitrate scan are absent.
scope_in: Add channels and supported-bitrates to adapter port.
Drive controls from capabilities.
Document bitrate scan and interface discovery roadmap phases.
acceptance_criteria: UI uses adapter-provided capabilities with deterministic fake-adapter tests.
Roadmap defines hardware acceptance for scan and discovery.

backlog_items.title: Prepare an approved future CAN transmit product path
backlog_items.priority: Low - transmission is intentionally absent but planned
problem: CAN transmit is out of current scope but needs a safe, explicit future decision rather than accidental implementation.
scope_in: Add roadmap milestone and prerequisite decisions: safety model, permissions, adapter capability, echo semantics, audit trail, and hardware acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap names prerequisites and a separate approval gate before any transmit backlog item can be promoted.

backlog_items.title: Remove domain UI text and duplicated formatting utilities
backlog_items.priority: Low - domain and presentation boundaries are blurred
problem: Domain produces English UI text and several helpers are duplicated.
scope_in: Move labels to presentation resources.
Remove unused column labels.
Consolidate duplicate default paths, numeric parsing, hex formatting, and bitrate definitions.
acceptance_criteria: Domain modules contain no presentation labels and one canonical helper exists for each consolidated concern.

backlog_items.title: Align documentation with delivered and roadmap capabilities
backlog_items.priority: Low - docs promise missing controls and capabilities
problem: Readme, scope, and UX delta claim features absent from code.
scope_in: Update capability statements.
Mark planned bitrate scan, discovery, BLF/MDF, adapters, and CAN transmit as roadmap.
Record Linux-only validation limit.
Validate and package the complete Logics chain with the audit evidence.
acceptance_criteria: No document claims unavailable functionality as delivered and each deferred capability has a roadmap reference.
The complete chain passes Logics validation, lint, and audit and includes the deep context pack.

orchestration_task.title: Deliver every September 2026 audit correction and future roadmap milestone
plan: Wave 1 High: reproduce all P0 defects as failing Linux tests, land profile recovery, bounded reservation, post-connect cleanup, malformed replay handling, session isolation, error backoff/reconnect, export ownership, abandoned-worker cleanup, and durable profile writes.
Wave 2 High: separate exhaustive data ingestion from visual coalescing; prove facts, caches, deferred decode, series, and reports against high-rate live and replay fixtures.
Wave 3 Medium: deliver bounded input, decode, graph, export, trace, and architecture work, prioritizing responsiveness proofs before UI evolution.
Wave 4 Medium: deliver the Fusion English visual system and diagnostic workflows, including aggregate IDs and always-gated acquisition controls.
Wave 5 Low: deliver finish work, recents, graph linkage, counters, extension ports, and an honest staged roadmap for bitrate scan, discovery, BLF/MDF, adapters, and future CAN transmit.

After every wave run focused tests; at closeout run the full Linux suite, Logics validation, lint, audit, and documentation consistency checks. Include the audit and supplied external evidence in the commit under operator control.
